method: A disposable real player instance per configuration, at origin/yaw90/facing +X. All MonoBehaviours, physics and colliders disabled; nested Animators disabled so only the actual root Mecanim Animator evaluates the skeleton. Real HandSocketEquipment.Equip attaches each weapon and assigns its saved override controller. Mecanim states are sampled directly at 101 inclusive normalized positions with FacingLeft=false, AttackSpeed=ActionSpeed=1, Attacking=true and Air=false. No custom Playable or capture-only pose rotation/grounding is used. World +X is forward. Central finite differences use the actual source clip duration.
limitation: Pose outreach/velocity extrema are measurements for human review, not automatic hit-window recommendations. A sword may contact during a swept arc before its maximum forward extension. No controller, source clip, saved timing, inventory, damage or projectile setting is modified.
